headline: Ghana political leadership demands import tariff adjustment to shield local rice farmers
summary: Dr Mahamudu Bawumia urged a fundamental rethink of Ghana's agricultural trade policies, demanding greater market protection for domestic rice producers against cheap imports.
why: Agricultural protectionism and tariff policies in West African economies affect regional grain import flows and domestic farming sector solvency.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Calls for import restrictions seek to bolster domestic rice production.
